subject: function:PlayerProcessPowerups
value:
RULE REQUEST, not a rule. This lane does not own webfrank and authored none. It reports that game/game/player.c::PlayerProcessPowerups has been driven to the point where its largest surviving cluster is a value-equal scratch permutation, and it supplies the source-exhaustion provenance the Mandatory-policy bar requires.

STATE AT COMMIT e77ef10ed (remeasure before acting): real 48, insns T1598/O1598, opcode multiset IDENTICAL 0t, 24 raw differing words, MNEMONIC DIVERGENCE 0, wf_word_diff class RECOLOR, fresh objdiff fuzzy 99.9124%, full ninja green with build/GUNE5D/main.dol: OK. Not pinned.

THE CLUSTER. Twelve of the 24 words are the tier-colour prologue at +0xdc0..+0xdf0. Five live values occupy five registers in each stream and every one of them is dead by +0xdf4, where the two streams re-converge on identical registers for the remaining 100-plus instructions of the block. The mapping target->ours is a single 5-cycle and is a BIJECTION:
  atree pointer   T r4 -> O r5   (+0xdc0 lwz, +0xdc4 cmplwi, +0xde0 rA)
  p->level / tier T r3 -> O r6   (+0xdcc lwz, +0xddc rD and rA, +0xdf0 rA)
  constant 10     T r0 -> O r4   (+0xdd0 li, +0xddc rB)
  p->index        T r6 -> O r0   (+0xdd4 lwz, +0xde4 rA)
  lbl_80282930@ha T r5 -> O r3   (+0xdd8 lis, +0xde8 rA)
No relocation payload differs in the cluster; the two relocated words (+0xdd8, +0xde8) carry the same @lbl_80282930 ADDR16_HA/ADDR16_LO pair in both streams and differ only in the register field.

WHY THIS IS NEWLY ELIGIBLE. Until commit e77ef10ed the cluster was NOT a bijection and no permutation-class rule could have applied to it: our stream held the quotient in r7, a sixth register the target never uses in the region (+0xddc read O 7ce523d6 = divw r7,r5,r4 against T 7c6303d6 = divw r3,r3,r0, and +0xdf0 read O 1c67000c = mulli r3,r7,12). A source edit closed that - see claim.law.SA_compound-assignment-coalesces-a-division-quotient-onto-its-dividend.20260903.v1 - taking six registers to five with no score movement at all. That is the whole content of this run's keep, and it is the reason the request is being made now rather than a run ago.

SOURCE-EXHAUSTION PROVENANCE (the Mandatory-policy citation chain). attempt.SA_playerprocesspowerups-volatile-half-is-a-bijective-scratch-permutation.20260903.v1 carries eight literal probed_form axes against this block, of which five are aimed at the cluster itself: the compound-assignment form (kept), hoisting the tier computation above its guard (28 words, 11 mnemonic divergences), moving the declaration to the enclosing block (byte-identical), removing the enclosing #pragma opt_propagation and its frame compensation (the twelve words came back byte-identical, so the pragma is NOT the colouring cause), and dissolving the tier local so the divide becomes a common subexpression (count parity lost, six extra divw). It supersedes attempt.SA_playerprocesspowerups-pool-literal-and-propagation-drive.20260902.v1, whose own probed_form trail carries four further axes and whose typed denial covers the block's callee-saved half.

WHAT IS NOT BEING REQUESTED. The other twelve words are out of scope for this request and must not be swept in: seven are the callee-saved r22/r24 source/parent transposition, which is a live typed denial with six negative probes and is a second lifetime of two registers whose FIRST definitions match (savedregs.py prints ASSIGNMENT MATCHES and is structurally blind to it); two are an FPR pair at +0x20/+0x30 with a live untried source hypothesis; two are an FPR transposition at +0xe50/+0xe64 across an fcmpu; one is the commutative fadd at +0x3a4 already proved source-unreachable. A rule covering only the +0xdc0..+0xdf0 cluster would leave real greater than 0, so this is a partial-closure request whose payoff is a class change, not an exact.

DEMAND CENSUS CAVEAT. This record is a request for an existing class to be applied to one function, not a request to commission a new capability. If the webfrank lane concludes the cluster needs a NEW class or mode, the demand-census rule applies to that decision and this function is one named customer, not a census.
